title: Log-Tilted Row Conditioning, Unconditional State-Space Barriers, Formal-Language Complexity, and Structural Generating-Function Theory for Higher-Dimensional Partitions
abstract: Bal (2026, arXiv:2611.34737v1) introduced recursive interior word conditioning for d-dimensional partitions, proving an exp(O_d(N^((d-1)/(d+1)) log(N+2))) bound for row conditioning (Algorithm R) and an exp(O_d(N^((d-1)/(d+1)))) bound for a diagonal interlacing refinement (Algorithm D), leaving open whether any row-only schedule can avoid the logarithmic factor. We resolve this question and establish the complete formal-language, distance-sensitive, residual-floor DAG, and generating-function theory of recursive word conditioning via four theorems backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (zero external imports, zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings), 16 AST-audited zero-float exact-Z/Q SHA-256 certificates (MANIFEST SHA-256: 4aa05a20cfe68d5632f293c1d69794281b00ee942b0892585d6027c95bae42f7), and 61 adversarial tests: (1) Log-Tilted Row Conditioning & Unconditional Algorithm-R Barrier: asymmetric log-tilted depths with gamma_d = 2/(d(d+1)) sharpen Algorithm R's upper bound to exp(O_d(N^((d-1)/(d+1)) (log N)^gamma_d)) (for d=3: (log N)^(1/6) vs. log N), while downward induction, staircase-perturbation coupling, and the grid injection y_delta(gamma) = H(D'-s(gamma)) + delta(gamma) prove an unconditional state-space lower bound exp(Omega_d(N^((d-1)/(d+1)) (log N)^gamma_d)) across all admissible schedules (K, S_{d-1}, ..., S_2) in {2,...,N}^(d-1); (2) Prefix-Closed Formal-Language Complexity & Exact Myhill-Nerode Separation: L_d is prefix-closed with containment monotonicity w' <= w, non-context-free for every d >= 1, and satisfies M_DFA(L_d^(<= n-1)) >= 1 + sum_{m=1}^{floor(n/2)} p_{d-1}(m) = exp(Omega_d(n^((d-1)/d))); (3) Distance-Sensitive Diagonal Weights & Residual-Floor DAG Theory: A_{M,ell}(N) <= exp(min{C_opt M^(2/3) N^(1/3), pi sqrt(2MN/(3(ell+1)))}) with C_opt = 3(sqrt(pi) zeta(3/2)/4)^(2/3) ~ 3.3074 < 1 + sqrt(pi)/2 zeta(3/2) ~ 3.3152, stretched-exponential decay beyond ell* = Theta((N/M)^(1/3)), sharp residual-floor cardinality |R_ell(alpha)| <= max(0, |phi|-ell-1), reachable vs. ambient separation, and strict monotone DAG potential Psi(alpha, R); and (4) Generating-Function Structure, Zero-in-Unit-Disk Obstructions, & Newton Inversion: (q;q)_n F(X;q), (q;q)_m T(alpha;q) in Z>=0[q] via Stanley (P,omega)-partitions, exact Euler-product trichotomy with unit-disk roots for P(q)=1+q^2+q^3, Q(q)=1+q+q^3, and floored R(q)=1+q-q^2, and exact embedding-dimension Newton inversion isolating single-k discrepancies (MacMahon k=4 at n=6 and GMMR k=6 at n=32 with delta=25422960).
